guard_runtime_probe.root_cause: CLOSED: the earlier 'not effective' reading came from two defects now fixed - (a) composer slash text reached the model as a prompt while the guard was never armed, and (b) the host rebuilds the extension runtime per turn so the factory-local GuardState lost arming between turns.
